parsed.summary: Tracing the schematic shows the intended architecture is present and consistent: two MCP2515 CAN controllers each clocked by a 16 MHz crystal (Y3), SN74LVC1G07 open-drain buffers wired as /OE-controlled e-stop sinks feeding the CAN connectors, an LTC4412 + P-MOS USB OR-ing path, a PCA9536 GPIO expander for power/5V-CAN control, an ADS1115 input-voltage ADC with a clamped divider, WS2812B LED chain and ISL54222 analog switches, and SM712-style CAN TVS protection. The apparent differences from the spec's component table (e.g. spec's Y1/Y2/U5/U8/U9/U11/U22 reference designators vs this build's Y3/U55/U53/U47/U11/U22, the 14.7456 MHz UART crystals, the README 'RS-485' vs CAN, the un-sequenced GLOBAL_EN, the 'USB diode doesn't work' note, the POE inverted-power jumper, and the C5 footprint note) are reference-designator/revision mismatches and explicitly documented known issues, not behavioral deviations. I found no drawing-supported anomaly.
